title: PTM Mechatronics
summary: A guided configurator for industrial agitators and pneumatic motors.
context: I built Forminator questionnaires for PTM’s industrial agitators and pneumatic motors. Customers enter their application requirements to configure a product or request a quote for an agitator with custom container dimensions.
contributions: Built the multi-step questionnaire with Forminator and added conditional navigation so customers could skip questions that did not apply.
Matched standard agitator configurations against a CSV lookup table and mapped motor selections directly to product SKUs.
Used those SKUs to select the corresponding WooCommerce bundle items and quantities, then calculated the total from WooCommerce prices via AJAX.
outcome: When the configurator found a match, customers could review the components and price and add the bundle to their cart. The custom container questionnaire collected technical requirements for a quote request.
